# Map libraries

Unmodified distribution assets from the npm packages `leaflet@1.9.4` (BSD-2-Clause) and `leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3` (MIT). Licenses accompany each library. Self-hosting allows reliable app-shell caching without a CDN dependency. No package installation is required to run the site.

When updating these assets, obtain the pinned packages with npm’s integrity verification, preserve their licenses and bump the cache version in `sw.js`.
